source: Publisher documentation saved under e3/truth/docs/fresh/ (sha256 in SHA256SUMS): TPC-DS v3.2.0; LDBC SNB specification (v2.2.5-SNAPSHOT, Appendix D for the Interactive v1 legacy data sets); GTFS Schedule Reference; FAA ardata.pdf (5/8/2025); ABS ASGS Edition 3 web pages; SEC Financial Statement Data Sets; College Scorecard Field of Study documentation (October 2026) and data dictionary; EPA AirData FileFormats (v3.0.0); 2024 ACS PUMS data dictionary and Census regions and divisions; City of Chicago portal metadata (ijzp-q8t2, c7ck-438e); USDA FoodData Central download field descriptions (October 2020)
rule: Sigma* is the set of FDs that the publisher documentation implies among the attributes of each relation, projected and closed over the dropped columns, each with a verbatim quote; sure when the quoted text states it (declared key, foreign key to a declared key, an explicit one-to-one or nesting statement), unsure when it needs an inference the text does not spell out. Dependencies the documentation hints at but does not state are listed under undocumented_regularities and are not part of Sigma*. Written from the documentation alone, before any data file was opened.

instance.generator: public data fixed before download for the confirmatory evaluation, joined by fresh.py
instance.construction: FAA Releasable Aircraft database (ReleasableAircraft.zip, the daily snapshot downloaded for the confirmatory evaluation, date in the README), column names of ardata.pdf (5/8/2025): MASTER (root) left-joined to ACFTREF on Aircraft Mfr Model Code and to ENGINE on Engine Mfr Mode Code; dropped the registrant name and address lines, city and zip, County Mail, Country Mail, Other Name 1-5, Kit Mfr, Kit Model (free text or personal data), Last Activity Date, Certificate Issue Date, Airworthiness Date, Expiration Date, Approved Operation Codes, Fractional Ownership, Unique ID, the master's Type Engine, ACFTREF's Type Engine, Aircraft Cruising Speed, TC Data Sheet, TC Data Holder and ENGINE's Pounds of Thrust to stay within 25 columns. Column names: the documented element names are the attribute names; the published files abbreviate them (e.g. MFR MDL CODE), and the spec reads those headers. The file's CERTIFICATION column is the whole field 'Certification requested and uses' (positions 238-247: the Airworthiness Classification Code and the Approved Operation Codes), so the attribute carries that name; only the key determines it.

cleaning.missing_values: empty and missing references become '?', kept as a value (null = null)

truth.clause: faa_ardata.pdf (document dated 5/8/2025), Aircraft Registration Master File (p. 1): "N-Number 1-5 5 Identification number assigned to aircraft." and (p. 8) "SEQUENCE N-Number (positions 1-5)"; (p. 1) "Contains the records of all U.S. Civil Aircraft maintained by the FAA"
truth.justification: The master file holds one record per registered aircraft, identified by its N-Number and sequenced by it.

audit.quote: "N-Number 1-5 5 Identification number assigned to aircraft." (p. 1); "Contains the records of all U.S. Civil Aircraft maintained by the FAA, Civil Aviation Registry, Aircraft Registration Branch, AFS-750" (p. 1); "SEQUENCE N-Number (positions 1-5)" (p. 8)

truth.justification: The master's Aircraft Mfr Model Code references the aircraft reference file, which is keyed (sequenced) by that code and identifies it.
